303:0.en: 「Earth isn't a place for war, is it?!」

303:163.en: 「All right!\nLet's try it, $$ホワイトドール$$!」

303:392.en: 「The Mustache's Beam Rifle\nisn't just for show!」

303:761.en: 「The $$ホワイトドール$$ will cover you!」

303:794.en: 「Scanning for enemies!\nNew heat source found, covering you!」

303:1094.en: 「No blessing from the $$ホワイトドール$$!?\nMoooove!!」

303:1153.en: 「Hang in there, $$ホワイトドール$$!\nYou're called Gundam, aren't you!?」

303:1282.en: 「Th-They're after the $$ホワイトドール$$...\nthe Gundam in particular!?」

303:1401.en: 「I can still manage with this much!」

303:1436.en: 「What? $$ホワイトドール$$'s rebound is weak!?\nCan't it handle this on auto!?」

303:1509.en: 「System check!\nDamage is smaller than I thought.」

303:1613.en: 「Do they hate the $$ホワイトドール$$...\nGot a grudge against the Gundam!?」

303:1709.en: 「The $$ホワイトドール$$'s armor\nshould be fine, but...!」

303:1764.en: 「I have to dodge properly next time!」

303:1801.en: 「Are they targeting the $$ホワイトドール$$!?」

303:1883.en: 「Damn, I was warned and got hit!」

303:1924.en: 「Do you insist on\nfighting me no matter what!?」

303:2070.en: 「The $$ホワイトドール$$ can dodge it!」

303:2142.en: 「No matter how accurate your aim,\nthis $$ホワイトドール$$ can!」

303:2243.en: 「Dodge it!\nYou're called a Gundam, aren't you?!」

303:2292.en: 「I can react to this much just fine!」

303:2482.en: 「I can do things like this too!」

303:2589.en: 「An attack from long range...\nI can't reach them from here.」

303:2638.en: 「Is the $$ホワイトドール$$ scaring them...?」

303:2727.en: 「Heading out in the $$ホワイトドール$$!」

303:2777.en: 「To end the fighting, I'll fight too!」

303:2845.en: 「I must stop that unit at all costs!」

303:2884.en: 「If I don't defeat you,\nsomeone will get hurt!」

303:2933.en: 「Right now, I have to do it...!」

303:3030.en: 「To use this, I have to get close...!」

303:3069.en: 「Close in and finish it at once!」

303:3090.en: 「$$ホワイトドール$$ can stop it!」

303:3146.en: 「With a Gundam, I can do it too!」

303:3173.en: 「With this machine... I can do it!」

303:3225.en: 「You can still move!? Then once more!」

303:3262.en: 「I won't let you run Earth your way!」

303:3303.en: 「If you try to make Earth yours,\nI will fight!」

303:3387.en: 「To think a Gundam is here too...!」

303:3424.en: 「Don't think you can\ncontrol us as well!」

303:3475.en: 「To build a world where people\ncan sleep in peace, I'll defeat you!」

303:3600.en: 「$$カミーユ$$, you go on ahead!」

303:3631.en: 「$$ガロード$$, I'll take it from here!」

303:3758.en: 「You're too far out front, $$ガロード$$!」

303:3876.en: 「Got it! I'll take that one for sure!」

303:4082.en: 「I was hit!?\nI have to move faster next time!」

303:4170.en: 「I can't make fine movements?\nDid something get damaged...?」

303:4322.en: 「No way! To be beaten this badly!」

303:4361.en: 「Players, everyone. Super Robot Wars is a game that really makes you want to see what happens next!」

303:4465.en: 「Super Robot Wars is a game that really makes you want to see what happens next!」

303:4563.en: 「If I have no choice, I'll do it...!」

303:4844.en: 「I won't let the war spread further!」

303:4924.en: 「To think this is all I can do...!」

303:4963.en: 「Even as we speak,\nsomeone is getting hurt...!」

303:5132.en: 「Fighting in the middle of a city...!」

303:5335.en: 「I should be able to push it back!」

303:5770.en: 「If my foe is a space monster...!」

303:5871.en: 「I knew it, it's a machine...!\nIts movements have a pattern...!」

303:5953.en: 「You too are a product of\nhuman wisdom!」

303:6033.en: 「I'm sorry...!\nThis is all I can do now!」

303:6082.en: 「If our hearts could just connect,\nnone of this would...!」

303:6135.en: 「How long will you keep up this war?!」

303:6178.en: 「Even a hateful past\ncan be overcome by people!」

303:6376.en: 「$$ハマーン・カーン$$!\nYou must be a far kinder person!」

303:6546.en: 「I can't fight this foe while\nprotecting myself...!」

303:6708.en: 「Even if I can't match its speed...!」

303:6809.en: 「I won't let you have your way!」

303:6848.en: 「Forcing selfish feelings on people\nwon't move them!」

303:6946.en: 「$$サイデリアル$$!\nDon't bring your war to Earth!」

303:7083.en: 「Depending on how it's used, it can\neven protect people!」

303:7140.en: 「No further!\nI won't let you spread that poison!」

303:7222.en: 「To turn the tide of battle,\nI have to stop that person...!」

303:7314.en: 「Those who crave battle must not\nrule over people!」

303:7441.en: 「Why does an emissary of God\ncommit such sacrilege?!」

303:7500.en: 「You have no right to judge people\nwho are doing their best to live!」

303:7569.en: 「Judging someone out of anger,\nthat's just wrong!」

303:7781.en: 「Trying to destroy humanity\njust because you were ordered...!」

303:7834.en: 「I can stop you even if I can't win!」

303:7877.en: 「Do you know how many people were\nmade unhappy by your selfishness?!」

303:7948.en: 「For the universe...! The world...!\nTo welcome a new tomorrow!」

303:8007.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nI won't hand you the future!」

303:8163.en: 「It can be used like this, too...!」

303:8213.en: 「It's not that I'm hitting back\njust because you hit me, but...!」

303:8461.en: 「$$ガロード$$, I'll take it from here!」

303:8604.en: 「Why do you take such risks, $$ヒイロ$$!」

303:8641.en: 「Don't let your guard down, $$ガロード$$!」

303:8699.en: 「If you're the $$赤い彗星$$, buck up!」

303:8798.en: 「We take them out one by one, right!?」

303:8827.en: 「I can't let them move in to help!」

303:9067.en: 「Good. If I can keep this up...!」

303:9129.en: 「I hope they give up after this...」

303:9207.en: 「Considering the hassle,\nI can't afford to get hit.」

303:9318.en: 「If it stays this minor, no problem」

303:9464.en: 「I'm being pulled into a bad flow...!」

303:9583.en: 「Not yet! Show me you can take it!」

303:9745.en: 「I can't be the only one to give up!」

303:9788.en: 「I'll do all I can in the time left!」

303:9831.en: 「To get back to the young ladies...!」

303:9868.en: 「The machine still moves...!\nI can keep fighting...!」

303:9970.en: 「Uwah! Is this as far as I go...!?」

303:10003.en: 「$$ロラン・セアック$$, leaving the front!」

303:10044.en: 「People living on another planet came from far across space, attacked, and invaded Earth.」

303:10121.en: 「To stop a great war that warps people's hearts, I decide to ride a mobile suit once more.」

303:10208.en: 「I hope we can somehow retake Earth...」

303:10253.en: 「Next time, 'The Stolen Earth'. A wind that shook the dimensions blew...」

303:10308.en: 「From the words of someone claiming to be an emissary of God, I learned that humanity is about to be destroyed.」

303:10385.en: 「The feelings of the many people who wish for peace come together and grow into a great power.」

303:10454.en: 「And so we made up our minds...!」

303:10485.en: 「Next time, 'The Golden Galaxy'. The wind crosses the dimensions...」
